description: This file contains the PHP class 'Activity' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Event'. The class extends the OpenCart system controller and defines various methods for logging different types of customer and system activities such as adding or editing customers, passwords, transactions, addresses, and other actions in an OpenCart e-commerce application. The class methods also include logic for tracking user actions and integrating with the activity model, conditioned on configuration settings.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Defines event handler methods for tracking user and system activities within the OpenCart Catalog module, specifically related to customer actions, address changes, transactions, and affiliates, with conditional activity logging based on configuration settings.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Logs the activity of a new customer registration if customer activity logging is enabled.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Logs the activity of editing customer details if customer activity logging is enabled.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Logs password change activity of the customer, identifies whether the customer is logged in or by email, and records the activity accordingly.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs the activity when a customer initiates a password reset process.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Logs a transaction activity related to a customer, including the associated order ID.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs activity of a customer creating a product return request.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs when a new affiliate account is added.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs editing activity related to an existing affiliate account.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs the event of a customer adding a new address.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Logs the editing of a customer's address.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Logs the deletion of a customer address.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs login activity, specifically when login occurs through certain routes, recording customer info if available.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds order history status update, and if customer activity logging is enabled, records activity based on order info, including status changes and activity type (order guest, order account).
